name: graphkeeper
description: Grounded, auditable memory for coding agents.

scripts.test:functional: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs dist/tests/unit dist/tests/integration dist/tests/e2e dist/tests/security
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs dist/tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs dist/tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs dist/tests/e2e
scripts.test:security: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs dist/tests/security
scripts.test:performance: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs dist/tests/performance
scripts.prepack: npm run validator:check && npm run build
scripts.release:verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:functional && npm run package:smoke
